formulas.precision: TP / (TP + FP) on reviewed candidate rows labeled TP or FP
formulas.recall: TP / (TP + FN) where FN comes from independent full-video review, not CSV rows

limitations: Recall is NOT MEASURED until fn_independent_video_review is supplied.
Unreviewed and Ambiguous rows are excluded from precision.
Metrics are candidate-level, not legal violation convictions.
